description: This file defines the FileSystemMonitor class with platform-specific implementations for Linux and Windows. It provides functionality to monitor file system changes, register/unregister callbacks, and notify observers of changes. It includes classes for managing observers, handling platform-specific file system notifications, and ensuring thread safety.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor
classes.description: Platform-specific class for monitoring file system changes, with nested classes for callback handling, observer management, and platform-specific implementations for Linux and Windows.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects that are notified when a file system change occurs.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Observer
classes.description: Manages a list of callback objects and notifies them of changes.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Context
classes.description: Platform-specific internal class for managing directory change notifications on Windows.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Dispatcher
classes.description: Thread class responsible for processing file system events on Windows.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the FileSystemMonitor.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the monitor is properly initialized and valid.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific file or directory to monitor changes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for a specific file or directory.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the processing of file system events (Windows).
